0022600101.text: The Grizzlies, now 1-0 and 2nd in the Southwest, are on the road against the Warriors, who are 0-1, 3rd in the Pacific and 1 game back, in Memphis' second game of the season. Memphis is without Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Brandin Podziemski (back soreness) and Charles Bassey (knee) also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Grizzlies lost all three games against the Warriors in 2025-26, most recently a 133-112 loss in Memphis on February 25, 2026.
